📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 2). Set the loop at head height for the target species. Anchor it solid. Camouflage the wire.
📖 LEARNED: Come Get Some (Level 2). You can goad a statue into flinching.

📖 Your old life taught you things. 6 skills from your past — check your Journal.
This is home ground. You grew up on country like this.

🪤 Your old life comes back to your hands: the pit you dug before the Scattering — deep enough for a boar, staked at the bottom, brushed over with leaves and marked well. You never forgot the shape of it.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Wei Fontana. Hunting guide. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Home key, Trail compass, Hard Candy, Field suture kit, Photo album. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something
